svg.text: REV B four-layer stackup (JLCPCB JLC04161H-7628, 1.6 mm) - thickness to scale x260 for dielectrics, copper exaggerated
L1 Cu 1 oz 0.035 mm: components, RF (50 ohm CPWG/microstrip), critical signals, GND pour [JLC04161H-7628]
L2 Cu 0.5 oz 0.0152 mm: continuous GND (only cut: NFC coil window) [JLC04161H-7628]
L3 Cu 0.5 oz 0.0152 mm: power (VSYS, 3V6, 3V3, 3V3_RF) + secondary signals, GND fill elsewhere [JLC04161H-7628]
L4 Cu 1 oz 0.035 mm: digital/aux signals, bottom parts, GND fill [JLC04161H-7628]
50 ohm on L1 referenced to L2 (h = 0.2104 mm): 2D FD quasi-static solve -> microstrip w = 0.36 mm: 50.3 ohm (no mask), 49.3 ohm (20 um mask);
CPWG w = 0.30 mm, gap 0.15 mm: 49.3 ohm. Hammerstad closed form gives 53.6 ohm for w = 0.36 (no thickness correction). Solver check: 123.1 vs 126.6 ohm reference (-2.8 %).
Final widths must be confirmed with JLCPCB's impedance calculator / controlled-impedance order; dielectric constants are the stackup file values, not measured.
USB D+/D-: 90 ohm differential on L1 over L2 (Espressif guideline), geometry to be solved at layout stage; ESP32-C3 USB is full speed (12 Mbit/s).
